title: Easily Extract Data from StatsWales
code: install.packages("statswalesr")

title: Easily Extract Data from StatsWales
code: library(statswalesr)  # List all published datasets (the full catalogue is fetched automatically) datasets <- statswales_list_datasets()  # Full-text search results <- statswales_search("hospital") results_fuzzy <- statswales_search("transprt", mode = "fuzzy")  # Browse by topic topics <- statswales_list_topics() topic_content <- statswales_get_topic(topics$id[1])

title: Easily Extract Data from StatsWales
text: Dataset IDs UUIDs returned statswales_list_datasets() statswales_search(). Results tidied analysis default: API’s internal *_sort columns dropped, whitespace padding stripped, numeric columns (including data values) converted numbers. Pass tidy = FALSE get API response -.
code: id <- datasets$id[1]  # Entire dataset, human-readable column names and values (default) df <- statswales_get_dataset(id)  # A single page of rows, if you don't want everything df_page <- statswales_get_dataset(id, all_pages = FALSE, page_size = 100)  # Welsh language df_cy <- statswales_get_dataset(id, lang = "cy-gb")

title: Easily Extract Data from StatsWales
text: filter argument list named lists. Multiple list elements use logic; multiple values within one element use logic.
code: # See what dimensions can be filtered filters <- statswales_get_filters(id) filters[[1]]$columnName   # dimension name (use as the key) filters[[1]]$values       # data frame of reference codes and labels  # Filter to specific values df_filtered <- statswales_get_dataset(   id,   filter = list(     list(Year = c("2022", "2023")),        # AND     list(Area = c("W92000004"))             # AND   ) )

title: Easily Extract Data from StatsWales
text: default package returns human-readable column names values. Override options argument: Note: July 2026 StatsWales API ignores use_raw_column_names use_reference_values — output always uses human-readable column names values. data_value_type currently changes output.
code: df_raw <- statswales_get_dataset(   id,   options = list(     use_raw_column_names = TRUE,   # internal fact-table column names     use_reference_values = TRUE,   # reference codes instead of labels     data_value_type = "raw"        # raw data values   ) )

title: Easily Extract Data from StatsWales
code: filters <- statswales_get_filters(id) pivot <- statswales_get_pivot(   id,   x = filters[[1]]$columnName,   y = filters[[2]]$columnName )

title: Easily Extract Data from StatsWales
code: meta <- statswales_get_metadata(id) meta$published_revision$metadata  # titles and summaries (both languages) meta$published_revision$designation  # "official", "accredited", etc.

title: Easily Extract Data from StatsWales
text: API stores query configurations deterministic 12-character ID. filter inputs always produce ID, making results shareable reproducible.
code: # Create a stored query and inspect it fid <- statswales_create_query(id, filter = list(list(Year = c("2023")))) query_info <- statswales_get_query(id, fid) query_info$totalLines  # total rows matching the query

title: Retrieve data for a dataset — statswales_get_dataset
text: dataset_id dataset UUID string. Use statswales_list_datasets() find dataset IDs. lang Language text values. One "en-gb" (default), "en", "cy-gb", "cy". page_number Page results return. Default 1. used all_pages = FALSE. page_size Rows per page. Default 10000 (API maximum). filter list filter objects. element named list mapping column name (statswales_get_filters()) character vector reference codes. Multiple list elements use logic; multiple codes within one element use logic. Example: list(list(Year = c("2020", "2021")), list(Area = c("W92000004"))). options named list display options: use_raw_column_names FALSE (default) returns human-readable column names; TRUE returns internal fact-table names. use_reference_values FALSE (default) returns human-readable values; TRUE returns reference codes. data_value_type One "raw", "raw_extended", "formatted" (default), "formatted_extended", "with_note_codes". Note: July 2026 StatsWales API ignores use_raw_column_names use_reference_values, output always uses human-readable column names values regardless settings. data_value_type currently changes output. sort_by Optional sort order. Either ready-made string API's "column:direction" format (e.g. "Year:desc"), named character vector c(Year = "desc", Area = "asc"). Directions "asc" "desc". all_pages TRUE (default), automatically fetches row-binds pages entire dataset returned. Set FALSE retrieve single page controlled page_number page_size. tidy TRUE (default), result cleaned analysis: API's internal *_sort columns dropped, whitespace padding stripped, numeric-looking columns (data values) converted numeric. Set FALSE return API response -.

title: statswalesr 1.0.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-12 Migrated StatsWales API v2 (https://api.stats.gov.wales/v2) Added sort_by argument statswales_get_dataset(), statswales_get_pivot(), statswales_get_topic(). Accepts either "column:direction" string named vector like c(Year = "desc") statswales_get_filters() now flattens hierarchical dimensions: values data frame gains parent level columns nested values (e.g. Wales → local authorities → wards) fully represented statswales_get_dataset() now uses two-step POST + GET flow; filters use new list(list(ColumnName = c("ref1", "ref2"))) format human-readable column names/values returned default statswales_search() restored full-text search across dataset titles summaries; supports mode argument (basic, fts, fuzzy, etc.) statswales_get_filters() path updated /{id}/filters statswales_download_dataset() now uses POST + GET filter ID flow; format query parameter rather URL path segment New statswales_get_pivot() cross-tabulated pivot views New statswales_create_query() generate reusable filter ID New statswales_get_query() inspect stored query configuration (total row count, column mappings, applied filters) statswales_get_dataset() results now tidied analysis default: internal *_sort columns dropped, whitespace padding stripped, numeric-looking columns (including data values) converted numeric. Set tidy = FALSE raw API response statswales_get_dataset() now returns entire dataset default (all_pages = TRUE); set all_pages = FALSE single-page retrieval. default page_size also raised 100 10000 (API maximum), datasets arrive single request statswales_list_datasets() now fetches full dataset catalogue automatically; page_number page_size arguments removed Timestamp columns statswales_list_datasets() statswales_search() now POSIXct (UTC) instead character API requests now retry transient failures (3 attempts)

title: statswalesr 0.4.0
text: Complete rewrite new StatsWales public API (https://api.stats.gov.wales/v1) Dataset IDs now UUIDs returned API; old alphanumeric codes longer apply New functions: statswales_list_datasets(), statswales_list_topics(), statswales_get_topic(), statswales_get_filters(), statswales_download_dataset() statswales_get_dataset() now calls paginated view endpoint returns data frame; set all_pages = TRUE auto-fetch pages statswales_get_metadata() restored — returns full dataset metadata including revision history Removed deprecated functions dependencies (lifecycle, rlang, curl, readr, httr) Replaced httr httr2; added jsonlite dependency Requires R >= 4.1.0
